import re, urllib.request as u, os, time, sys
def gdl(fid, out):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out), exist_ok=True)
    for attempt in range(5):
        try:
            page = u.urlopen('https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=' + fid).read().decode()
            if 'Quota exceeded' in page:
                wait = 60 * (attempt + 1)
                print(f'Quota exceeded for {out}, retry in {wait}s (attempt {attempt+1}/5)', flush=True)
                time.sleep(wait)
                continue
            uuid = re.search(r'uuid.*?value="([^"]+)', page).group(1)
            u.urlretrieve('https://drive.usercontent.google.com/download?id=' + fid + '&export=download&confirm=t&uuid=' + uuid, out)
            size = os.path.getsize(out)
            if size > 10000:
                print(f'Downloaded {out}: {size} bytes', flush=True)
                return
            print(f'Download too small ({size}b), retry in {60*(attempt+1)}s', flush=True)
            time.sleep(60 * (attempt + 1))
        except Exception as e:
            print(f'Error: {e}, retry in {60*(attempt+1)}s', flush=True)
            time.sleep(60 * (attempt + 1))
    raise RuntimeError(f'Failed to download {out} after 5 attempts')
